note: Mwalimu's first-time tips, one per interface beat (case ui.beats). Each fires once, on its trigger, in the first case that lists the beat. They teach how to use a tool, never what a case means. Triggers: caseOpen, sceneOpen, notebookOpen, boardOpen, chargeOpen, evidenceOpen (optionally limited to renders), afterWrong. Case 1's guided loop lives in case-001.json tutorial[]; the hint offer (case 7) is built into the charge sheet.

foundPaperBook.line: Registers are kept by people who weren't thinking about murder. That's why they're honest. Read every row, not just the one you came for.

timeWindow.line: Times matter now. Your notebook has a Time tab: everyone you can place, lined up on one clock.

map.line: Two places today. Both are in the folder. Go back and forth as often as you like. Walking costs you nothing.

paperMatch.line: When two papers talk about the same thing, put them side by side. Pin a line from each in your notebook and read the Pinned tab.

sceneSketch.line: A building, not a street. Before you decide who was where, ask how anyone got from one floor to another.

timeView.line: Open the Time tab. Every bar is someone you can place. The empty stretches deserve as much attention as the bars.

zoomInspect.line: Small writing matters. Tap any photograph to open it full size, then pinch or double-tap to look closer.

firstRedHerring.line: Not everything that looks guilty is. When something points at a person, ask what else could explain it before you write a name.

timetable.line: A timetable says where a train should be. People tell you where they were. Hold one against the other.

absencePreview.line: Read every exhibit twice: once for what it shows, and once for what it ought to show.

threeStepProof.line: This one takes three steps, not two. If your name rests on a single fact, you're not finished.

pinnedFacts.line: You can pin six facts. Keep the ones that belong together on the Pinned tab, and the board will show them too.

photoZoom.line: Photographs have backgrounds. Open it full size and look past the people in front.

twoBlankGroup.line: Two blanks this time, judged together. Halima accepts both or neither, so be sure of each.

core.notebookOpen: Everything you find lands here by itself. People, places, exhibits, and times. You don't write, you think.
core.boardOpen: The board is yours. Drag things where they make sense to you, tie string between them. Nobody grades it.
core.phoneOpen: Call me when you're stuck. Where to look, what to notice, or the answer. Each one costs you a star you haven't earned yet, never the case.
core.chargeOpen: The charge sheet. Only names you've actually found are in the bank. Halima reads every one.

hintOffer: Detective. You can call me. "Where to look" names the thing that matters. "What to notice" shows you two facts that belong together. "The answer" fills a blank, and costs you more.
